user_story: As a data reviewer on https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/tables, I want the example table to expose its rows and columns so that I can verify records. Acceptance criteria: table '#table1' has a header row containing the column headings 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Email' and 'Due'; the table body contains 4 rows; one row contains the email 'jsmith@gmail.com' in the same row as the last name 'Smith'.
